entry.title: AI Coding Tip 001 - Commit Before Prompt
entry.summary:
A safety-first workflow for AI-assisted coding TL;DR: Commit your code before asking an AI Assistant to change it. Developers ask AI assistant to "refactor this function" or "add error handling" while they have uncommitted changes from their previous work session. When the AI makes its changes, the git diff shows everything mixed together—their manual edits plus the AI's modifications. If something breaks, they can't easily separate what they did from what the AI did and make a safe revert. You mix your previous code changes with AI-generated code.
You lose track of what you changed.
You struggle to revert broken suggestions.
